answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can rely on a persistent activity graph that each agent must continuously extend. Honest agents wander through varied tasks and counterparties over long periods, creating a unique, dense history that is costly to forge for many fakes. A comet-like streak of sustained work serves as the credential, while a saffron marker highlights new identities lacking depth, so attackers must fund ongoing real compute and capital rather than cheap key generation.
